en.title: Season One Original Soundtrack
en.description: Salutations! Good to be back on the air! Hazbin Hotel Original Soundtrack for Season One pressed on Hell Splatter. Side A Happy Day In Hell Hell Is Forever Stayed Gone It Starts With Sorry Respectless Whatever It Takes Poison Loser, Baby Side B Hell's Greatest Dad More Than Anything Welcome To Heaven You Didn't Know Out For Love Ready For This More Than Anything (Reprise) Finale
